description: A man in a dark, shadowy workshop, in a sleeveless vest over rolled-sleeve shirt, leans over a large wooden loom and pulls a cord with one hand while the other rests on a wooden beam. A wooden shuttle with pointed iron ends is shown in mid-air, passing through a sheet of taut warp threads. The background holds wooden framing, pulleys and gears, and shelves with objects. Era cues are a hand-operated wooden loom and pre-industrial clothing. No text, letters or numbers are visible, and no frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge. Nothing graphic.
